themes.evidence: Our story begins with what it truly means to be a technology innovator.

We supply the industry’s most comprehensive range of products and services, from exploration through production, and integrated pore-to-pipeline solutions that optimize hydrocarbon recovery to deliver reservoir performance sustainably.
Our curiosity drives us to better understand what our customers do, how they do it, and what they need to help overcome their challenges.
We believe energy makes society progress, so we find ways to help our customers fuel agriculture, industry, medicine, science, space, technology, and transportation.
Our common sense of purpose unites 82,000 people representing 170 nationalities with products, sales and services in more than 120 countries.
